contacts_all.note: All partner rows, including the partners behind users and companies

users.note: Internal users (users.csv plus the task users)

audit_messages.note: Field-change tracking messages in the chatter (closest Odoo counterpart of an audit trail)

job_runs.note: Scheduled-action run records (closest Odoo Community counterpart of a job history; Odoo vacuums them after a week)

approvals.note: Purchase orders, the documents behind Odoo Community's only approval flow (two-step order approval)

companies.note: Companies and branches (not a 100,000-row list in either product)

roles.note: Access groups, the Odoo counterpart of roles (not a 100,000-row list)
